profile.headline: Wrapbook ∘ Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Passionate software developer with a desire to improve web based applications that follow object oriented programing (OOP) principles. I am a speedy learner who loves the steps of debugging and test-driven development (TDD) design. When no instruction is given, I thrive and am capable in designing and databasing applications from the ground up while working independently and/or in teams. My background is in hard sciences and management where I have implemented scalability solutions for my teams productivity. 

One day I'd like to like to apply my software and science knowledge to a company that integrates both to improve the health and well-being of mankind. Feel free to message me to connect. I am also reachable at klaudiastewart@gmail.com
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Keywords: software developer - backend engineer - backend developer - software engineer - full stack software developer - full stack software engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented technologies such as Angular, TypeScript, and Ruby/Rails to develop software and write new features for production
- Contributed to engineering team by participating in code reviews, software testing, optimization of product, and paired programming
- Constructed RESTful APIs from ideation to inception to be used within the product front-end
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · RubyMine · Angular · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Back End Engineering Student
positions.description: - Develop web based applications with Ruby on Rails and SQL while using test driven development (TDD) principles and employing object oriented programming (OOP) structure

positions.title: Manufacturing Chemist
positions.description:
- Manufactured, provided analytical verification, and document quality control of all chemical products assigned to the Waters Analytical Standards and Reagents team while following SOPs
- Assisted production team to meet production schedules and customer delivery dates

positions.title: Organic Chemistry Preparation Analyst
positions.description:
- Analyzed and tested environmental waters from government clients via continuous liquid-liquid extraction, HPLC, and GC-MS while following standard EPA procedures
- Prepared reagents, standards, and concentrations to be inspected in analytical instrumentation

positions.title: Workshop Manager
positions.description:
- Supervised and taught up to 30 students on how to make hats, rosaries, gift sets, and sandwiches for various homeless communities in the Denver metro area
- Coordinated with administrators to organize annual organization parties while directing dozens of volunteers year-round
